title: Sahara's Singing Sand Mystery

scenes.text: At 250 meters, Sahara dunes start to sing
Fine silica grains rub together, creating a resonant hum when wind blows
scenes.label: GRANULE SHAPE TRIGGERS HUM

scenes.text: Higher daytime temperatures expand the grains, amplifying the vibration into audible tones
scenes.label: HEAT AMPLIFIES VIBRATION

scenes.text: Similar singing dunes exist in California’s Kelso and China’s Taklamakan, proving it’s a global sand secret
scenes.label: OTHER SINGING DUNES

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: Discover why the Sahara’s dunes can produce eerie music and how temperature and grain shape make it happen. The planet hides many such acoustic wonders.
